name: Trueshot Lodge Training's bleed bonus only applies while wielding a polearm (#3310)
contract: Trueshot Lodge Training rank 1 (803113) reads 'Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 25%. While wielding a polearm, the damage of your bleed effects is increased by 25%.' Its effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, Amplitude 10000 ms, casting the helper 803854 on the caster with BasePoints 25 carried via SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0. 803854 applies SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (SPELLMOD_DOT, MiscValue 22) on class mask (0, 4096, 2147483776) = bits matching Serrated Shot's SpellFamilyFlags[2]=128, for 11000 ms (DurationIndex 38, bridging the 10 sec retrigger). 803854 carries EquippedItemClass 2 / EquippedItemSubClassMask 64 (polearm) but AttributesEx3 is 0 - neither SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON nor _OFF_HAND_WEAPON - so Spell::CheckItems (Spell.cpp) never calls Item::IsFitToSpellRequirements for it, and the periodic cast (TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK, which does not include TRIGGERED_IGNORE_EQUIPPED_ITEM_REQUIREMENT) lands with any weapon, or none. spell_ascension_ranger_trueshot_lodge_polearm (src/server/coa/AscensionRangerSecondary.cpp) adds an OnCheckCast hook on 803854 that requires the caster's main-hand weapon to satisfy 803854's own equipped-item requirements (the same Item::IsFitToSpellRequirements the engine already runs for the ATTR3 case). Expected: with a non-polearm main-hand weapon, spell_modifier(Serrated Shot 500073, SPELLMOD_DOT) stays at its unmodified base of 1000 through at least one 10 sec tick; after swapping to a polearm, the next tick raises it by 25% to about 1250. Before the fix the bonus reaches 1250 even without a polearm equipped.

steps.label: SETUP: Trueshot Lodge Training is active
Fast Test 1H Axe - not a polearm
Cross the first 10 sec periodic tick
CONTRACT: no bleed bonus without a polearm equipped
Cross the next 10 sec periodic tick
CONTRACT: the bleed bonus is 25% once a polearm is equipped
